title: Partner Keyring
description: v1/partners.json, the partner keyring nginx-ui hosts fetch. Generated by scripts/build-partners.mjs from partners/*.json and signed in CI with the project's release key into v1/partners.json.minisig. Hosts only trust it when that signature verifies. Do not hand edit.

updated_at.description: Moves forward whenever partners or revoked change. Hosts refuse a keyring older than the one they cached.

partners.description: Partner keys, sorted by name. A package signed by one of them installs as verified, with or without a partner certificate.

revoked.description: Key ids, sorted, that are no longer partner keys on any host, whatever certificate a package carries.
